description: A STALE_UPDATE from the quick Status select shows the raw server text plus 'Your draft is preserved. Review the latest context before making a new edit.' The quick select has no draft, and the notice names no field, no newer value and no author.
expected: Something like 'Juniper changed the status to Completed while you were choosing. Pick again if you still want In progress.' with the select showing the latest value.
actual: 'This field changed since it was read; refresh its context' / 'Your draft is preserved…' / Dismiss
suggested_fix: Use a quick-select-specific message for task.update without an editor draft; name the field and newer value; omit draft wording.

description: At 1440×900 the Task details panel covers the Review column, so the card that just moved is clipped ('Fix flaky webhoc…') and the column header count is hidden.
expected: The destination column and the moved card stay visible, or the board scrolls to show them.
actual: The card is mostly hidden under the panel.
suggested_fix: Let the board area shrink beside the panel instead of being overlaid, or scroll the selected card into view after a status move.

description: Each computer contributes a 'Setup agent · agent' Actor. With three computers, the header shows 'SA SA' avatars, and the Assigned-to filter lists 'Setup agent · agent' three times with no way to tell them apart.
expected: Infrastructure agents are hidden from people-facing lists or named after their computer/owner.
suggested_fix: Exclude setup agents from presence and assignee lists, or label them with their owner/device.
